_comment: The official MaidCentral API, transcribed from the docs. Fill in during Phase 0: one entry per documented endpoint. 'verified' = called successfully by npm run probe. Response shapes come from capture/output/official-probe.jsonl, not from here.
status: Docs not yet read: support.maidcentral.com was blocked by the cloud session's network policy on 2026-11-02. Only /token is listed, from a public search result.
auth: POST /token with username, password and grant_type (password or refresh_token); then Authorization: Bearer <token>.

endpoints.purpose: Get a bearer token for the API user (grant_type=password) or refresh it (grant_type=refresh_token)
